chunks: "When the people take their places at Minā, a caller calls out to them: If you knew in whose courtyard you have lodged, you would surely be certain of recompense after forgiveness."

key_terms.الْخَلَفِ: replacement, recompense, or abundant return after what was spent or undergone
key_terms.بِفِنَاءِ: in the courtyard or presence of, indicating nearness to divine hospitality
key_terms.مُنَادٍ: a caller or announcer proclaiming a message
key_terms.مِنًى: Minā, the sacred hajj site where pilgrims stay during the rites

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the call made to pilgrims when they settle in Minā?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a divine proclamation to the pilgrims when they settle in Minā, reminding them of the sanctity of the presence in which they have arrived. It emphasizes that hajj brings not only forgiveness, but also assured divine compensation and blessing thereafter.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "When the people take their places at Mina, a caller announces to them: 'If you knew in whose presence you have settled, you would be certain of receiving abundance after forgiveness.'"
